name: Shokushuu no Miko ~ Kinjirareta Shitei Shokushu Koukan
original_name: 触囚の巫女 ～禁じられた姉弟触手交歓
source:
Takeru was cleaning the shrine as he did each morning when he stumbled and crashed into a tree. The impact revealed an old vase-like encasement... a mysterious vase with an ancient seal that was now broken! A multi-limbed horror of Nyarlathotep sprawled out into freedom, insane with rage, not caring who had sealed it away... it seized Takeru and his buxom step sister, shrine maiden Sakuya...!

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063504.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
和每天早上一样，Takeru正在打扫神社，突然绊倒并撞到了一棵树上。撞击显露出一个古老花瓶般的外壳……一个神秘的花瓶，上面有古老的封印，现在已经被打破了！奈亚拉托提普的多肢恐怖体伸展开来，自由自在地伸展开来，愤怒得发疯，根本不关心是谁将它封印了……它抓住了武和他丰满的继妹，巫女咲夜……！

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063504.html]DLSite English[/url]]
